tasks.label: Inspect booking implementation

tasks.label: Inspect booking routes and views
args: Get-Content routes/booking.js; Get-Content views/booking.ejs; Get-ChildItem views -Name; Get-ChildItem routes -Name; Get-Content .gitignore; Test-Path .env; Test-Path package-lock.json; Test-Path node_modules/stripe

tasks.label: Inspect appointment persistence
args: Get-Content services/appointmentService.js; Get-Content routes/myAppointments.js; Get-Content views/partials/header.ejs; git status --short; Select-String -Path .env -Pattern '^STRIPE_SECRET_KEY\s*=' -Quiet; Select-String -Path .env -Pattern '^BASE_URL\s*=' -Quiet

tasks.label: Check Stripe integration files
args: node --check data/db.js; node --check services/appointmentService.js; node --check routes/booking.js; node --check routes/bookingSuccess.js; node --check server.js; Write-Output ('STRIPE_SECRET_KEY configured: ' + [bool](Select-String -Path .env -Pattern '^STRIPE_SECRET_KEY\s*=\s*\S' -Quiet)); Write-Output ('BASE_URL configured: ' + [bool](Select-String -Path .env -Pattern '^BASE_URL\s*=\s*\S' -Quiet)); Write-Output ('Stripe dependency installed: ' + (Test-Path node_modules/stripe)); Get-Content routes/booking.js; Get-Content routes/bookingSuccess.js; Get-Content server.js

tasks.label: Validate Stripe integration syntax and configuration
args: node --check data/db.js; node --check services/appointmentService.js; node --check routes/booking.js; node --check routes/bookingSuccess.js; node --check server.js; Get-Content .env | ForEach-Object { ($_ -split '=')[0] }; Test-Path node_modules/stripe; Get-Content .gitignore

tasks.label: Validate Stripe integration syntax
args: node --check data/db.js; node --check services/appointmentService.js; node --check routes/booking.js; node --check routes/bookingSuccess.js; node --check server.js; npm.cmd ls stripe --depth=0

tasks.label: Check local app listener
args: $c=Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if ($c) { $p=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$($c.OwningProcess)"; Write-Output ($p.Name + ' ' + $p.ProcessId + ' ' + $p.CommandLine) } else { Write-Output 'No listener on port 3000' }

tasks.label: Restart clinic app with Stripe routes
args: $c=Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if ($c) { $p=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$($c.OwningProcess)"; if ($p.Name -eq "node.exe" -and $p.CommandLine.Contains("server.js")) { Stop-Process -Id $p.ProcessId -Force; Write-Output "Stopped previous clinic server" } else { throw "Port 3000 is owned by a process other than this clinic server" } }

tasks.label: Stop previous clinic server
args: $c=Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if ($c) { Stop-Process -Id $c.OwningProcess -Force; Write-Output StoppedClinicServer }

tasks.label: Check Stripe key presence
args: if (Select-String -Path .env -Pattern '^STRIPE_SECRET_KEY\s*=\s*\S' -Quiet) { Write-Output PRESENT } else { Write-Output MISSING_OR_EMPTY }

tasks.label: Recheck Stripe key presence
args: if (Select-String -Path .env -Pattern '^STRIPE_SECRET_KEY\s*=\s*\S' -Quiet) { Write-Output PRESENT } else { Write-Output MISSING_OR_EMPTY }

tasks.label: Check Stripe test key format
args: if (Select-String -Path .env -Pattern '^STRIPE_SECRET_KEY\s*=\s*sk_test_\S+' -Quiet) { Write-Output TEST_KEY_PRESENT } elseif (Select-String -Path .env -Pattern '^STRIPE_SECRET_KEY\s*=\s*\S+' -Quiet) { Write-Output VALUE_PRESENT_BUT_NOT_TEST_KEY_FORMAT } else { Write-Output MISSING_OR_EMPTY }

tasks.label: Restart app for Stripe test
args: $c=Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if ($c) { Stop-Process -Id $c.OwningProcess -Force; Write-Output Stopped }

tasks.label: Review Stripe booking implementation
args: Get-Content routes/booking.js; Get-Content routes/bookingSuccess.js; Get-Content services/appointmentService.js; Get-Content data/db.js; Get-Content server.js; Get-Content package.json; if (Select-String -Path .env -Pattern '^STRIPE_SECRET_KEY\s*=\s*sk_test_\S+' -Quiet) { Write-Output STRIPE_TEST_KEY_PRESENT } else { Write-Output STRIPE_TEST_KEY_MISSING_OR_EMPTY }; Get-Content .gitignore

tasks.label: Check local base URL setting
args: if (Select-String -Path .env -Pattern '^BASE_URL\s*=\s*\S+' -Quiet) { Write-Output BASE_URL_PRESENT } else { Write-Output BASE_URL_MISSING_OR_EMPTY }

tasks.label: Confirm clinic project safety notes
args: Get-Content C:\Users\Paul\.codex\memories\MEMORY.md | Select-Object -Skip 78 -First 14; Select-String -Path C:\Users\Paul\.codex\memories\rollout_summaries\2026-10-21T16-01-11-PfaK-clinic_express_ejs_booking_sqlite_auth_testing.md -Pattern 'DB_PATH|Logged-in booking email|testing be performed autonomously'

tasks.label: Check inherited SMTP settings safely
args: if (Test-Path Env:SMTP_HOST) { Write-Output SMTP_HOST_IN_PROCESS } else { Write-Output SMTP_HOST_NOT_IN_PROCESS }; if (Test-Path Env:SMTP_PORT) { Write-Output SMTP_PORT_IN_PROCESS } else { Write-Output SMTP_PORT_NOT_IN_PROCESS }; if (Test-Path Env:SMTP_USER) { Write-Output SMTP_USER_IN_PROCESS } else { Write-Output SMTP_USER_NOT_IN_PROCESS }; if (Test-Path Env:SMTP_PASS) { Write-Output SMTP_PASS_IN_PROCESS } else { Write-Output SMTP_PASS_NOT_IN_PROCESS }; if (Test-Path Env:SMTP_FROM) { Write-Output SMTP_FROM_IN_PROCESS } else { Write-Output SMTP_FROM_NOT_IN_PROCESS }

args: curl.exe -s -o NUL -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:3000/; curl.exe -s -o NUL -w " %{http_code} %{redirect_url}" http://localhost:3000/reception
